To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the eigenfunctions of our fuzzy laplacian are fuzzy Bessel functions, that they are the natural generalization of the ordinary Bessel functions to the fuzzy setting, that they form a complete orthonormal basis, that the eigenfunctions can be computed in closed form, and that they have a nice interpretation as the eigenfunctions of fuzzy angular momentum.

the fuzzy Bessel functions are eigenfunctions of a fuzzy laplacian on a fuzzy disc, that they have the same asymptotic behavior as Bessel functions, and that they can be used to approximate the Bessel functions of integer order.

the fuzzy laplacian has eigenfunctions which are called fuzzy Bessel functions; these functions are related to the eigenfunctions on the ordinary disc; the fuzzy Bessel functions have a well-behaved limit as the fuzziness tends to zero; and the limit is the ordinary Bessel functions of first kind.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a matrix model for the disc which is a generalization of the fuzzy sphere.
the following question: how can one define a basis of eigenfunctions for the fuzzy laplacian on a fuzzy manifold?
the study of the algebra of functions defined on the fuzzy disc.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fuzzy disc is the matrix analogue of the disc and the fuzzy Bessel functions are its eigenfunctions.
the fuzzy Bessel functions are the eigenfunctions of our fuzzy Laplacian on the fuzzy disc and that the Bessel functions of first kind are the eigenfunctions in the commutative case.

the eigenfunctions of fuzzy laplacians are fuzzy Bessel functions, and the corresponding eigenspaces are fuzzy spaces of Bessel functions, which in the commutative limits tend to the spaces of Bessel and Hankel functions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have introduced a fuzzy laplacian on fuzzy manifolds, which is a generalization of the ordinary laplace operator.

, in this paper, we construct the algebra of functions over the fuzzy disc in a basis of eigenfunctions of a fuzzy laplacian, we show that in the commutative (i.e. classical) limit these eigenfunctions tend to Bessel functions of order zero and we show that they are the matrix elements of a representation of the quantum enveloping algebra of $U_q(\mathfrak{sl}(2))$ for $q=1$.
we have found a way to construct the eigenfunctions of any matrix approximation of a laplacian, which is a very useful tool for the study of matrix approximations of laplacians in general.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the algebraic structure of functions on the disc is preserved at all scales of the fuzzy disc.
the eigenfunctions of any matrix laplacian are the matrix analogues of Bessel functions of any order.
these functions have a very simple form in the fuzzy limit and are very close to Bessel functions of order zero, which makes them a natural basis for the study of fuzzy spaces.
